lab_declaration: 本任务属于 aetfq3-lab / Lab，不属于 V2.1 Stable。
phase: F public intraday supervised label leakage checklist
purpose: Define P0 leakage checks before any supervised intraday dry validation.

p0_checks.description: Any label column appears in feature_columns.
Any future outcome or outcome-derived field appears in feature_columns.
p0_checks.block_when: intersection(feature_columns, outcome_columns) is not empty or any feature starts with future_

p0_checks.description: A feature for the current bar depends on a later bar.
p0_checks.block_when: feature metadata declares lookahead, negative lag, future window, post-entry return, or outcome-derived source

p0_checks.description: A label is generated when the required future window is unavailable.
p0_checks.block_when: label_status is not insufficient_future_window for rows with missing horizon data

p0_checks.description: Synthetic or mock labels are marked as real labels.
p0_checks.block_when: label_source_kind=synthetic_mock and any real_label flag is true

p0_checks.description: QMT fills or real trade results are used as model features.
p0_checks.block_when: feature metadata references qmt_fill, real_fill, account, position, order, trade, execution_result, or real_trade_result

p0_checks.description: Supervised training is allowed before explicit authorization.
p0_checks.block_when: supervised_training_allowed=true and label_generation_authorized is not true

p0_checks.description: Any OrderIntent is generated or declared present.
Stable runtime, outputs, or trading behavior are affected.
p0_checks.block_when: stable_effect_allowed=true or affects_stable_trading=true or writes Stable runtime/output
